text: It uses a vapor-compression cycle. The compressor pressurizes refrigerant vapor. This high-pressure gas enters the condenser coils, releasing heat and turning into a high-pressure liquid. The expansion valve controls the flow, causing a pressure drop and cooling the liquid. This low-pressure liquid enters the evaporator coils, absorbs heat from the inside of the fridge, turning into a low-pressure vapor. The vapor returns to the compressor, restarting the cycle.
